name: Palia – Bugs
description: The bugs of Palia, by behavior, with normal and starred variants.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle
Quest: It Takes a Village - Elouisa

items.name: Amber Mantis
items.description: Amber mantises feast on the resin dripping from the Lantern Ash, which also gives them their unique golden hue.

items.name: Ancient Amber Beetle
items.description: One of the oldest known insects species in Palia, was said to exist in the time of humans. Found in the forests of Bahari Bay. Also has a chance to be found when chopping trees in Bahari Bay.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Ancient Flowbug
items.description: A rare species of bioluminescent fauna that was previously thought to be a myth. Bahari Glowbugs are said to have descended from them.
tags: Quest: It Takes a Village - Elouisa

items.name: Azure Stonehopper
items.description: This little blue beauty has been known to camouflage itself as a shiny blue pebble. Found in the fields of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Bahari Bee
items.description: A local species of bees, known to produce delicious honey. Has a chance to be found when chopping trees in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Bahari Crab
items.description: A local crab, known to taste good with drawn butter. Found along the coast of Bahari Bay. Also has a chance to be found when foraging shells in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Bahari Glowbug
items.description: A local species of bioluminescent fauna. Discovered by Professor Bonlin Amepongo. Found in the fields of Bahari Bay during the evening and night.

items.name: Banshee Beetle
items.description: Much like its cousin the Shadvaraak Beetle, it appears to be a genetic hybrid. When given a scent, the Banshee Beetle will let out a piercing shriek as soon as it detects the owner nearby.

items.name: Blood Beetle
items.description: Named for the startling red markings splashed across this beetle's exoskeleton. Despite the name they actually prefer feasting on piksii berries over anything sanguine.

items.name: Blue Crab
items.description: Feeling blue? So's this crab.

items.name: Blushing Batterfly
items.description: A batterfly that spends most of its time flitting among the bioluminescent foliage of the Elderwood's caves.

items.name: Brighteye Butterfly
items.description: Whenever you see the sun out, you can see the eyes of this intricately patterned butterfly looking around Bahari Bay. Found in the Forests of Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Brushtail Dragonfly
items.description: The tail of this Dragonfly is so bright and vibrant, some early Majiri were said to have used it as a paintbrush. Found around the lake in Kilima, as well as rivers and ponds in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Cave Piksii
items.description: This Piksii lives under the staircase mushrooms that grow along the walls of caves in the Elderwood. Be careful where you tread, lest you disturb one and face its tiny wrath.

items.name: Cerulean Cicada
items.description: The call of this cicada is so soothing, it was said to be the inspiration for Ayana's fourth symphony. Found attached to trees in Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Common Bark Cicada
items.description: A common cicada. Found attached to trees in Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Common Blue Butterfly
items.description: Ever resilient. Butterflies of this type can be found in almost every climate in Palia. Found all around Kilima and Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Common Field Cricket
items.description: Field crickets can be found anywhere you can find a field. Found all around Kilima and Bahari Bay.

items.name: Draugr Beetle
items.description: One might mistake the bright coloring on its armor for natural markings, but they're actually a sign of the parasitic fungus that has taken control of this unsuspecting beetle.

items.name: Duskwing Butterfly
items.description: A beautiful butterfly with wings the color of dusk. Unique to the Kilima Valley. Found around the Dragon Shrine in Kilima during the morning and day.

items.name: Enfield Moth
items.description: So named for its discoverer, Lucrezia Enfield, who ventured into the Royal Highlands to establish the Enfield Manor. She died of a mysterious illness soon after the construction crew broke ground, leaving [[:Majordomo Enfield|M

items.name: Fairy Mantis
items.description: A mantis from early Majiri legend only recently confirmed to exist by modern entomologists. Said to have magical properties. Found in the fields of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Firebreathing Dragonfly
items.description: This Dragonfly is notoriously difficult to catch, in part due to its fiery breath. Found in the fields of Kilima.

items.name: Flame Queen
items.description: The Flame Queen was once a Phoenix Moth. After reincarnating ten thousand times, the Queen emerged and established her dominion over the Royal Highlands. Perhaps it would be wise to pay fealty with a tasty tapestry or a bite of your favorite dress, lest you feel

items.name: Flame-Horned Rockhopper
items.description: Despite the name, its horns are as cool and slimy to the touch as the rest of this rockhopper. It uses its fiery appearance to intimidate potential predators.

items.name: Garden Ladybug
items.description: A black and red ladybug, popular for controlling garden pests. Has a chance to be found when foraging in the fields of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Garden Leafhopper
items.description: The Garden Leafhopper is such a delight in Palia that many children keep them as pets. They are said to bring good luck. Found in the fields and Badruu's Farm in Kilima. Also has a chance to be found when foraging in Kilima.

items.name: Garden Mantis
items.description: Nothing to see here. Just your garden variety mantis. Found around the lake in Kilima. Also has a chance to be found when foraging around the lake in Kilima.

items.name: Garden Millipede
items.description: A brown and green millipede that loves feasting on garden crops. Found in the fields of Kilima. Also has a chance to be found when foraging in the fields of Kilima.

items.name: Garden Snail
items.description: A snail that has evolved over time to look like a leaf. Good for hiding from predators, bad for hiding from the Leafstalker Mantis. Found along the coast and in forests of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Golden Glory Bee
items.description: A rare bee, imported from the Akwindu province. Mead made from this bee's honey is said to be heavily consumed by the Queen of the province and her family. Has a chance to be found when chopping trees in Kilima during the morning and day.

items.name: Gossamer Veil Moth
items.description: The wings of this moth are so thin that some say you can see a peek of the Dragon Realm by looking through them. Found in the fields of Kilima during the evening and night.

items.name: Grumpy Granite Rockhopper
items.description: It is impossible to tell if this rockhopper is genuinely mad at you, or if its face just looks that way.

items.name: Hairy Millipede
items.description: A millipede with a hair growth problem. Found in the forests of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Heartdrop Mantis
items.description: The Heartdrop Mantis is a docile creature. It's said that when one crosses your path, you're soon to meet your true love.

items.name: Inky Dragonfly
items.description: This stealthy Dragonfly is used as a component in various black dyes and inks. Found around rivers and ponds in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Jewelled Mantis
items.description: The Jewelled Mantis is known to bury its eggs near Jadium deposits, then jealously guard the ore as its own.

items.name: Jewelwing Dragonfly
items.description: A Dragonfly with wings as bright and colorful as any precious stone. Found near a cave entrance on a cliff in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Kilima Night Moth
items.description: While beautiful, the Kilima night moth is so prevalent on hot summer nights that some consider it to be a pest. Keep away from stored cloth. Found all around Kilima and Bahari Bay during the evening and night.

items.name: King Crab
items.description: Who made him king? Presumably, the other crabs. Only spawns from collecting shells.

items.name: Leafstalker Mantis
items.description: An herbivorous mantis that exclusively eats leaves. Has a chance to be found when foraging in the forests of Bahari Bay.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Lunar Fairy Moth
items.description: The Lunar Fairy Moth is said to have a very special connection to the Dragon Moon, and is said to only appear at special times during its cycle. Found in the fields and forests of Bahari Bay during the evening and night.

items.name: Mossy Moth
items.description: The Mossy Moth has adapted to the overgrown ruins that dot the Highlands by camouflaging as the moss that clings to the ancient stones.

items.name: Nightshadow Batterfly
items.description: This batterfly only comes out under the cover of night and canopy both.

items.name: Paper Lantern Bug
items.description: This bug glows as brightly as a colorful feast day lantern taking flight into the Palian night sky. Found along the coast and in forests of Bahari Bay during the evening and night.

items.name: Phoenix Moth
items.description: The Phoenix Moth is technically immortal- when it reaches the end of its natural life it engulfs itself in a cocoon of Flow, from which a caterpillar will soon emerge to start the cycle anew.

items.name: Princess Ladybug
items.description: A very regal looking lady bug, made popular by the children's fairytale, The Princess Who Turned Into A Ladybug. Found around the lake in Kilima.

items.name: Proudhorned Stag Beetle
items.description: The horns of this stag beetle are said to resemble that of the Proudhorned Sernuk. Has a chance to be found when mining in Kilima.

items.name: Pumpkin Rockhopper
items.description: This rockhopper has evolved to sport a rather spooky face on its back, likely to scare away predators. Just don't let it scare away YOU!

items.name: Rainbow-tipped Butterfly
items.description: Ancient legends say this rare butterfly got its beautiful coloring from dipping the tip of its wings in a Well of Flow. Found in the Fields of Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Raspberry Beetle
items.description: A beetle whose entire diet consists of raspberries. Found around Badruu's Farm in Kilima.

items.name: Scintillating Centipede
items.description: A rare centipede with a shiny hard shell. Has a chance to be found when mining in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Shadvaraak Beetle
items.description: Thought to be a genetic hybrid of a standard stag beetle mixed with a shadvaraak, leading to a highly aggressive creature with a venomous horn.

items.name: Shimmerfly
items.description: Shimmerflies only grace Kilima with their rainbow light in brief periods during their migration season, which makes the joy of experiencing them all the more beautiful.

items.name: Spineshell Crab
items.description: A crab with a very spiny shell. Found along the coast of Bahari Bay.

items.name: Spitfire Cicada
items.description: A spirited cicada, whose bark is worse than its bite. Found attached to trees in Bahari Bay during the morning and day.

items.name: Spotted Mantis
items.description: A rare mantis with a beautiful set of spots. Found around the Dragon Shrine in Kilima.

items.name: Spotted Stinkbug
items.description: A bug known more for his strong musk than its striking colors. Found all around Kilima and Bahari Bay.

items.name: Stripeshell Snail
items.description: A snail with such distinctive stripes, that its shell was once used as a currency among the early Majiri. Found along the coast in Bahari Bay.

items.name: Sunburst Batterfly
items.description: Unlike its light-averse brethren, this batterfly thrives under the meager light of the Elderwood.

items.name: Vampire Crab
items.description: An invasive species of crab that sucks the life out of the local population. Found around the Flooded Fortress in Bahari Bay during the evening and night.

items.name: Veil Piksii
items.description: These Piksiis are said to form from the Flow of those unable to cross the Veil. Strange that so many should populate the Elderwood.

items.name: Whispering Widow Moth
items.description: Legends say those who hear the whispers of this moth will soon experience a great loss.

items.name: Will-o-wisp Rockhopper
items.description: This pale rockhopper is said to glow softly in the dark of the Elderwood, luring unwitting travelers deeper into the marsh.
